_comment: 1:1 port of GC's TConEvo Thaumcraft Infusion recipe TCONEVO_PRIMALMETAL. Decompiled from tconevo-1.12.2-1.0.38.jar / xyz/phanta/tconevo/integration/thaumcraft/ThaumHooksImpl.class. Original GC recipe: TC Infusion at the Infusion Matrix, instability=5, vis=30 Metallum + 15 Aer + 15 Terra + 15 Ignis + 15 Aqua + 15 Ordo + 15 Perditio (= 120 Vis total), research-gated by TAR_PRIMALMETAL. Center=Coalescence Matrix, surround=primordial_pearl + salis_mundus, output=1x primal_metal_ingot. SoA mapping: Hephaestus Forge ritual is the closest mechanical 1:1 to TC Infusion (both are multi-block ritual altars with center+surround+essence costs+tier gate). Forge tier 5 requirement matches the master_wizard research gate. Essence costs map TC's 7 aspect groups to F&A's 4 essence types: Aureal (Aer/Ordo/Metallum), Blood (Terra/Ignis/Aqua), Souls (Perditio), Experience (proxy for instability cost).
